name: game-studio
description: Design, build, extend, and verify games across engines with coordinated design, art, and gameplay workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Create and improve games across engines.
interface.longDescription: An engine-independent game production workflow covering game design, architecture, visual direction, production assets, and player-focused verification. Preserves your chosen engine and existing project.
defaultPrompt: Create a playable game from this idea using a suitable engine.
Add a feature to the current game without regressing existing play.
Diagnose and fix a gameplay bug, then verify the affected flow.
